Testing Against SURA: What Happened & Should We Believe It?

7 real-world seats played by competing LLMs across 9 scenarios (including R8 ★ Heavyweight Rematch & R9 ★ Nixon-1969 Costly-Signal Test).

Q1. Were the AI Decisions Sensible?

R8–9★: ~90% Sharp • R1–7: ~75%

In R1–R7: China (DeepSeek) and Anthropic (Opus 5.5) played smartly, but weak Luna wasted turns as OpenAI, Argon contradicted itself as US Gov, and Grok balked at playing a deceptive AI.

In R8 ★ & R9 ★ (Heavyweights): Upgrading OpenAI to Sol 6.1 (via Codex), SURA to Sonnet 5.5 High, and US Gov / AI to Gemini Carbon eliminated those blunders—and completely overturned R1's optimistic pause!

Q2. Did We Get Any Useful Results? (Post-R8★ & R9★)

5 Real Insights • Ignore Raw %s
  • Global pause treaties didn't happen (0 of 9 runs): Neither superpower freezes in 2nd place, and the Senate won't ratify without chip inspections.
  • Anthropic "burning its lead" failed against an equal-IQ OpenAI (R8 ★): Sol 6.1 overtook Anthropic in Turn 1 via talent poaching + Super-PACs, so Anthropic paused 0 times.
  • Even when halting was wired to shock DC & Beijing (R9 ★), Anthropic STILL paused 0 times: No lab board voluntarily jumps while OpenAI is 4 points away—even though jumping + waking up DC/Beijing tripled counterfactual survival (18% → 56%).
  • US-only bans get blocked by PACs (R8–9 ★) or hand #1 to China (R4): Compliant Anthropic stops, OpenAI moves offshore, and Beijing takes #1.

Which Assumptions Actually Changed Survival?

Across 2,250 test runs, how hard AI safety is technically mattered 5x–10x more than activist protest tactics or Senate treaty rules.

Best estimate: Where the Real World Lands by End of 2030

Combining the wargame's structural lessons with real-world political and capital constraints:

3 Moves That Helped in Every Single Scenario:

1. Harden model weight security immediately (unhardened labs got robbed by spies repeatedly across the suite).

2. Build verification & deception tests now before a crisis or parity window arrives.

3. Fund safety pauses outside VC runway so pausing once doesn't bankrupt the safety lab.
